The '''Staff of Command''' was the [[Cane/Legends|cane]] wielded by the [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The staff served as a symbol of their position as ruler of [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]], the planet's ruling hive. One notable Archduke to wield the staff was [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], Archduke prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It is believed that a section of the cane was made up of part of the corpse of the previous Archduke of Geonosis, [[Hadiss/Legends|Hadiss the Vaulted]]. Poggle carried the staff with him throughout the Clone Wars until he was assassinated by Darth Vader on Mustafar. During the massacre of the leaders, Poggle unsuccessfully tried to use the staff to defend himself. Vader slashed through it with his lightsaber and killed Poggle, destroying the staff in the process.
